content_sections.heading: Cabinet Secretariat DFO Technical Recruitment 2026 – Quick Summary
content_sections.text: Who is recruiting? Government of India, Cabinet Secretariat. Which post? Deputy Field Officer (Technical). How many vacancies? The notification states a total of 250 (tentative). The subject-wise figures printed in the notification add up to 250 (see the vacancy section below). Who can apply? Indian Nationals with a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology, or a Master's degree in Science, in one of the notified subjects, and a valid GATE Score Card. Application start date: Not specified in the notification. Last date: 15 November 2026 (last date for receipt of applications). Application mode: Offline. The filled-in form must be sent by ordinary post. Job location: The initial posting is at New Delhi. The job involves field postings with All India Transfer liability.

content_sections.text: The notification lists subject-wise vacancies, which it describes as tentative. Candidates must hold the matching GATE paper in a valid GATE Score Card. The notification states the total as 250, but the subject-wise numbers printed below add up to 250. The notification does not explain this difference, so candidates should confirm the figures in the official notice. content_sections.heading: Cabinet Secretariat DFO Technical Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is checked as on the closing date. Candidates must satisfy the age limit, the educational qualification and the valid GATE Score requirement. They must also clear the character and antecedent verification and the medical examination. Applicant must be an Indian National. Applicant must have qualified in the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) and hold a valid GATE Score Card. A valid GATE Score means the candidate achieved qualifying cut-off marks in GATE 2024, 2025 or 2026 in the notified subjects. A candidate can apply for only one subject out of the notified subject codes. The combination of the educational qualification and the GATE paper must match the subject table above.

The degree must be from a recognised University or Institution. The candidate's GATE paper in the valid GATE Score Card must correspond to the subject applied for.

content_sections.heading: Cabinet Secretariat DFO Technical Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on the GATE Score and an Interview. It is subject to the candidate fulfilling the prescribed eligibility criteria, character and antecedent verification, and a medical examination. All applications received by the closing date that satisfy the eligibility criteria will be arranged in order of merit on the basis of valid GATE Score, for each subject separately. Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of valid GATE Score, in a number five times the number of vacancies, and called for Interview. Final selection is based on GATE Score and Interview. Selected candidates are subject to character and antecedent verification and a medical examination. The medical standard will be as per the Central Government guidelines applicable to Group 'B' posts. The notification does not give the marks or weightage for the GATE Score and the Interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Cabinet Secretariat DFO Technical Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must send the duly filled-in Application Form along with self-attested copies of the following documents. Mark-sheets and certificates (hard copy) of Matriculation, 10+2, B.E. / B.Tech. / M.Sc. Birth Certificate or other relevant documents (Matriculation Certificate, Passport, Driving License, PAN Card) in support of age. Valid GATE Score Card. Caste Certificate (Annexure-I or Annexure-II), for age relaxation, if applicable. NOC from present employer, if applicable. Undertaking (Annexure-III) and discharge certificate, in case of ex-servicemen. Two recent passport size coloured photographs, with name and date of birth on the back. Self-attested copy of the Aadhaar Card (the application form carries the instruction to attach it).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Cabinet Secretariat DFO Technical Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notification describes an offline process. It does not mention an online application link or an official website for applying. Choose one subject out of the notified subjects and note the corresponding GATE subject code. Fill in the Application Form, "Application for the post of Deputy Field Officer (Technical) in Cabinet Secretariat (Government of India)", printed with the notification. The form must be typed on A-4 size paper and filled in English capital (block) letters using black or blue ink only. Do not leave any column blank. Affix a self-attested recent passport size coloured photograph. Sign the declaration with the date and place. Attach the self-attested copies of all required documents. Put the application form and documents in an envelope and send it by ordinary post to: Post Bag No. 001, Lodhi Road Head Post Office, New Delhi-110003. Make sure the application reaches the address on or before 15 November 2026, which is the last date for receipt of applications.

content_sections.heading: Cabinet Secretariat DFO Technical Application Form Details
content_sections.text: The application form printed in the notification asks for the following information. Subject applied for, subject of B.E. / B.Tech. / M.Sc., and the corresponding subject code in GATE. Name of the candidate, nationality, gender, address for correspondence (state and PIN code clearly), and native place. Mobile number (mandatory) and alternate number; email ID (mandatory, in block letters) and alternate email ID. Aadhaar number, father's name, mother's name, date and place of birth, age as on closing date, and religion. Category (General, SC, ST, OBC, Ex-Serviceman, Central Govt. Employee or Others). A self-attested copy of the requisite certificate must be enclosed when claiming age relaxation. For ex-servicemen, the length of Defence Service (with a self-attested copy of the discharge summary). Marital status and, if married, name, religion and nationality of spouse. Educational qualifications from matriculation onwards (as on closing date): exam / degree passed, board / university, month and year of passing, duration of the course, subjects studied, and total marks obtained in percentage / CGPA. GATE details: year of passing, GATE roll number, subject paper and code, GATE score, GATE marks out of 100, and the date till which the GATE Score Card is valid. Whether employed or not and, if yes, details of employment (department, rank, pay level, date of joining) with a self-attested copy of the NOC from the employer. Declaration that the candidate fulfils the eligibility conditions for the post and has not submitted any other application in response to this selection process.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for Cabinet Secretariat DFO Technical Candidates
content_sections.text: Applications without a photograph or the requisite certificates / information will not be entertained. Unsigned or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Persons in Government service must submit their applications through their respective office and should enclose the Certificate (Annexure-IV) issued by the Competent Authority for claiming age relaxation, if required, as per Government Rules. The job involves field postings with All India Transfer liability. The exact date, time and centre of the interview will be intimated to the shortlisted candidates through their e-mails. The Cabinet Secretariat reserves the right to cancel or withdraw the recruitment process, or revise the number of vacancies, at any stage without assigning any reason. If any information is found incorrect at any stage, the candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled or terminated without notice, as stated in the declaration.

content_sections.heading: Annexures Printed with the Notification
content_sections.text: The notification includes four formats that candidates may need, depending on their category. Annexure-I notes that ST candidates belonging to Tamil Nadu State should submit the caste certificate only from the Revenue Divisional Officer. Annexure-II states that the OBC certificate must also certify that the candidate does not belong to the persons / sections (Creamy Layer) mentioned in the Government of India Department of Personnel and Training O.M. No. 36012/22/93-Estt (SCT) dated 8.9.1993, as amended from time to time. Annexure-IV is to be filled by the Head of the Office or Department and certifies the pay scale and 3 years of regular service in the grade as on the closing date.
